name: smwgraphics-the-magical-quest-starring-mickey-mouse-fire-grotto
title: The Magical Quest Starring Mickey Mouse - Fire Grotto
description:
Animated BG from the SNES Mickey Mouse game. Uses the first few colors of Palette 0 and Palette 3.
Only BG1 is used. AnimationGFX.bin goes into the slot for the animated GFX.
Makes use of LM 1.7+ palette rotate animation feature and 8x8 tile animation. (4 slots in total used)
